_doc: Install-page recipes for scripts/dev/device-install.py. Each entry is a page that was first resolved by a person or an AI session and then promoted, with its UI dump saved under install-pages/ as a fixture. `--self-test` checks every recipe still matches its fixture. See docs/DEVICE_TESTING.md for when a page is worth promoting.

recipes.observed: 2026-09-11, vivo V2166BA, Android 13 (SDK 33); first resolved by an AI session via --inspect/--tap-text
recipes.notes: 「继续安装」 looks grey until the box is ticked, yet its inner layer stays clickable and enabled in the UI tree, so the button's own state cannot tell whether it is ready. The tap is gated on the checkbox reading checked=true instead. The label is drawn on two nested layers; the outermost clickable one is tapped.

recipes.observed: 2026-09-11, HONOR CLK-AN00, Android 14 (SDK 34); first resolved by an AI session via --inspect/--tap-text
recipes.notes: First of HONOR's pages: a bottom dialog accepting responsibility for an app of unknown origin. It is a separate window, so the UI tree holds only the warning and 取消/继续 — no app name or version. require_app is therefore off; the adb install-session check (size of this APK) is what proves the install is ours.
require_all: 来历不明的应用很可能会损害您的手机和个人数据
